about: the adapted embedders of app/eval/adapted_embedders.py: what each was trained from and on, its loss after every epoch, its resume segments and the sha256 of its checkpoint files. The checkpoints are not in the repository; a row that uses one records weights_sha256, and a load is checked against reference_embeddings

spec.about: the bar row: bge-small fine-tuned by the MarginMSE recipe on all three corpora's training lists

load_and_score.query: What is the capital of China?

recipe.data: bench/distill/queries.jsonl.gz and teacher_scores.jsonl.gz as committed by M43, never regenerated; the trainer refuses to run if either file's sha256 differs from its meta; every training id must be in queries.jsonl.gz with split train
recipe.teacher: mixedbread-ai/mxbai-rerank-large-v2 (not re-run): its raw logits, fp32, max_length 512, one per candidate
recipe.list: the fused top 20 of hybrid@bge-small for a synthetic query, plus its source document when it is not among them, in the committed order
recipe.student_score: s * cos(E(q), E(d)): E is the SentenceTransformer forward (Transformer, CLS pooling, Normalize) on the model's own preprocess() output, the path encode() takes, so training and serving cut a long passage at the same token; each unique text is tokenized once; queries and documents bare (no prompt)
recipe.scale: s is fixed per init and training set before training, by a label-free rule: s = std(t_i - t_j) / std(c_i - c_j), numpy std with ddof 0 in float64, pooled over every pair i < j (the list's committed order) of every training list of that training set, t the teacher's logit and c the init model's cosine; recorded with 1/s and the epoch-0 validation loss in bench/distill/embedder_scale.json
recipe.loss: MarginMSE over every pair of one list: the mean over i < j of ((s_i - s_j) - (t_i - t_j))^2, s the student's score and t the teacher's logit (M43's definition); the first step is checked, torch against numpy
recipe.optimizer: AdamW, betas (0.9, 0.999), no weight decay on biases and LayerNorm weights
recipe.schedule: linear warm-up over the first 10% of the steps, then linear decay to zero
recipe.corpus_mixing: each list of a step comes from a corpus drawn with probability proportional to the square root of that corpus's number of training lists; inside a corpus lists are drawn without replacement and reshuffled when exhausted
recipe.precision: float32 throughout: torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 False and float32 matmul precision 'highest'; both, with torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32, recorded in training.json and every results header
recipe.memory: micro_lists (M43) on a GPU under 40 GB, recorded per resume segment: a memory setting, never a hyper-parameter
recipe.validation: the synthetic queries of the held-out source documents (M43's split field): never a gold question, a tune-half question or a BEIR query
recipe.selection: the epoch end (1 to 4) with the lowest macro validation MarginMSE (each corpus's mean list loss, then the mean over the arm's corpora); ties go to the earlier epoch; whether the chosen epoch is the last is recorded; the source document's mean rank inside its validation list is recorded per epoch as a diagnostic and is not used
recipe.seeds: 0 for every arm; 1 and 2 for the bar recipe only, as an exploratory spread

mnrl.formula: cross-entropy over 20 * cos(q, every in-batch candidate), query to document (sentence-transformers 6.1 MultipleNegativesRankingLoss defaults), hand-written so that it can mask
mnrl.lists: only the lists where the teacher ranks the source document first; the source is the positive
mnrl.hard_negative_rule: the teacher's bottom half of the list (the 10 lowest-scored candidates of a 20- or 21-candidate list), the first 7 of those in the list's order
mnrl.batches: all 32 queries from one corpus, the corpus drawn with probability proportional to the square root of its eligible lists; no source document twice in a batch: a list whose source is already in the batch is deferred to that corpus's next batch, never dropped; deferrals counted per epoch
mnrl.mask: for each anchor, every in-batch candidate whose doc id equals the anchor's own positive doc id scores -inf, except the anchor's own positive column; masked entries counted per epoch
mnrl.selection: the epoch end with the lowest masked loss on the validation lists where the teacher ranks the source first, in batches built once with seed 0 (each corpus's mean, then the mean over corpora)
mnrl.hardware: a card of 40 GB or more, no micro-batching; resumed only onto such a card

memory.note: how a step's lists were split for the GPU's memory; the optimizer steps once per lists_per_step lists either way
